'''Wandau''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who worked for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ellin Lah]] onboard the ''[[Woebegone]]'' and was one a group of traders who traveled through the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]], where it supplied several worlds with seafood.

==Biography==
Wandau once served as a a bodyguard for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] until he decided to quit and join Ellin Lah's crew. He had once encountered a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the Klatooinian for honorable purposes.

As Wandau and his comrades set out on a journey to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], they realized that a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] was hiding in the stowaway onboard the ''Woebegone''. The Muun was revealed to be [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and he asked the entire crew to take him back to his homeworld. After Wandau and the others came to the consensus and rejected his offer, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] attacked. Wandau tried to take advantage of taking a seemingly defenseless Plagueis after the Muun [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|threw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at [[Semasalli]] and [[Blir']], but Plagueis caught him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The impact hurled Wandau against the ceiling, paralyzing him from the waist down. He was still able to speak to Plagueis, mistaking him for a Jedi. To him, the Muun was a disgrace to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] which he served; he could've just used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in a more peaceful manner. Plagueis, uncaring, replied in Wandau's [[Klatooinian (language)|native language]] that he was weak-willed and useless before putting him out of his misery.
